# Primuez Autonomous Ecosystem Manifest
> Authoritative documentation and knowledge index for Primuez, InkTwin, and PrimuezSure.
> Architect & Founder: Rahul Kasturiya (https://primuez.in)

## Core Platforms
- [Primuez Main Platform](https://primuez.in): Autonomous AI agents, enterprise n8n workflow engineering, and B2B systems.
- [Ink Twin](https://inktwin.primuez.in): Proprietary AI handwriting synthesis, homework automation, and custom font builder.
- [PrimuezSure](https://primuezsure.primuez.in): Enterprise RAG policy analyzer for commercial insurance and fine-print gap detection.
